info.description: Products and access management system endpoints

Issues new access and refresh tokens using an existing Bearer token (can be expired) and refresh token.

200.description: List of API keys retrieved successfully

parameters.description: Number of products to return (1 - 10,000, default 50)

parameters.description: Scroll ID returned from previous product search or scroll request

post.summary: Bulk create products from JSON file
post.description: Uploads a single JSON file (max 5MB) containing an array of products with their variants to be indexed in Elasticsearch.

file.description: JSON file containing an array of products with variants (application/json, max 5MB)

200.description: All products in bulk file created successfully

400.description: Invalid file, schema validation error, or list of errored documents

Failed to update product / internal server error

500.description: Failed to create variant / internal server error

302.description: Redirects to the presigned MinIO URL
